data.desc: Eocene Ltd. (NASDAQ: EOCN) is a GI-focused medtech and biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Givatayim, Israel, dedicated to advancing innovative solutions across gastrointestinal disease management, GI oncology and related therapeutic areas. The Company is building a diversified platform that combines medical devices, therapeutics and enabling technologies to address significant unmet clinical needs and improve patient outcomes. Eocene's wholly owned subsidiary, Galmed Research & Development develop Aramchol, a first-in-class synthetic fatty acid-bile acid conjugate molecule being evaluated in liver disease and oncology indications, including gastrointestinal cancers. Eocene's wholly owned medtech subsidiary Colospan Ltd., is a commercial-stage medical device company developing solutions designed to transform postoperative colorectal care.
